title: Nursing expertise in ECMO care: Skills, challenges and prospects
summary:
In intensive care medicine, critically ill patients are sometimes treated using a specialised heart-lung support system known as ECMO. Nurses bear a particularly heavy responsibility in this context. However, there has been no detailed description to date of the specific knowledge and skills nurses require for this demanding form of care.
The aim of this study is therefore to systematically identify the most important nursing competencies for the care of ECMO patients and to develop a questionnaire based on these. This questionnaire is intended to help highlight and assess these competencies.
To this end, professionals from nursing, medicine and perfusion technology will be interviewed, scientific literature will be reviewed, and the developed questionnaire will subsequently be validated. Participation consists of anonymous surveys and group discussions; no procedures or treatments will take place.
conditions: A nursing science study on nursing competence and quality of care in the intensive care of patients receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO)

interventions.name: The project will examine experts from the fields of nursing science, clinical nursing practice, nursing education, medicine and perfusion technology who have experience in ECMO care. Data collection will be carried out sequentially and using methodological triangulation: nursing competencies in ECMO

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The study will include experts from the fields of nursing, medicine and perfusion technology who have prior experience in intensive care or medicine and – depending on the study component – proven practical experience in ECMO care. A prerequisite for all empirical study components is voluntary participation following receipt of written study information and consent. For the Delphi method and the focus group, specialist expertise in the context of intensive care and ECMO is required, whilst the quantitative validation study includes nursing staff with current ECMO experience.
Exclusion criteria:
Anyone who does not meet these criteria will be excluded.
